findings.title: Email input has no accessible label
findings.explanation: The input relies only on a placeholder, so it has no programmatic label for screen readers.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `<label htmlFor="email">Email</label>` and an `id` on the input.

findings.title: Submit control is a clickable div
findings.explanation: The div has an onClick but no role, tab stop or keyboard handling, so keyboard and assistive-technology users cannot submit.

findings.title: Avatar image has no alt attribute
findings.explanation: The image has no `alt`, so screen readers announce the file name or skip it.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a descriptive `alt`, or `alt=""` if the avatar is decorative.

findings.title: Custom modal has no dialog semantics or focus management
findings.explanation: The modal is plain divs: no `role="dialog"`/`aria-modal`, no initial focus, no focus trap and no Escape handling in the code shown.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the native `<dialog>` with `showModal()` or an accessible dialog library.

limitations: Expected result for the evaluation harness; labelled by the maintainers.
